name: Genesis
lede: The first book of the Bible, in full: every scene and every line of dialogue in the words of the ASV.

books.name: In the Beginning
books.blurb: The six days and the seventh, the dust of the ground and the breath of life, the garden eastward in Eden, the woman, the serpent, the fruit, and the way east of Eden.

books.name: Cain to the Flood
books.blurb: Cain and Abel, the mark of Cain and the city of Enoch, the book of the generations of Adam, Enoch who walked with God, the ark of gopher wood, the flood, the raven and the dove, and the bow in the cloud.

books.name: Babel to Abram's Covenant
books.blurb: The table of the nations, Nimrod the mighty hunter, the tower of Babel, the generations of Shem, the call of Abram, Egypt and Pharaoh's house, Lot and the Plain, the war of the kings, Melchizedek, the stars, and the covenant between the pieces.

books.name: The Cities of the Plain
books.blurb: Hagar and the fountain in the way to Shur, Ishmael, the covenant and the new names Abraham and Sarah, the three men at Mamre, Sarah's laughter, Abraham pleading for the righteous, the night at Lot's door, and brimstone and fire on the cities of the Plain.

books.name: The Son of Promise
books.blurb: Abimelech's dream at Gerar, the birth of Isaac and Sarah's laughter, Hagar and the lad at a bowshot in the wilderness, the oath at Beer-sheba, the mount in the land of Moriah and the ram in the thicket, and the cave of Machpelah.

books.name: A Wife for Isaac
books.blurb: Abraham's servant and the oath, ten camels to the city of Nahor, Rebekah at the well with her pitcher, Laban, I will go, Isaac meditating in the field at eventide, Keturah, Abraham full of years, and Ishmael's twelve princes.

books.name: Jacob and Esau
books.blurb: Two nations in the womb, the hand on Esau's heel, red pottage and the birthright, Isaac at Gerar and the wells Esek, Sitnah and Rehoboth, the blind father, the kids of the goats, the stolen blessing and Esau's bitter cry.
